# HTML cases for the desktop Word run

Not yet answered; the desktop-Office run fills in the last column. The files are generated by `HtmlExportTests.Writes_the_cases_for_the_desktop_office_run_when_asked`
(`ONEDOCUMENT_HTML_CASES=<dir>`), and the hashes below are of the committed copies.

| File | sha256 |
|---|---|
| `report.docx` (generated test document: headings, styles, lists, table with merges and header row, footnote, links, picture, right-to-left paragraph, page break) | `866d33d7e3ba0bba2efed91a9941c884ba40c10c3015f723ecb6fc103ee63a85` |
| `report.html` (our export of `report.docx`) | `7049d580e04ced73dfa3ce8c420c0351f0e5333c367ab87ecfc8148774092cee` |
| `report-from-html.docx` (our import of `report.html`) | `671270c71e46ec6e51864a223df6b3ba9a066839337abe88dcf5e74b0469fda6` |

| # | Request | Record | Answer |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Open `report.html` in Word | opens without a repair or security prompt; page count; text of each paragraph; whether headings get the Heading 1/2 styles; list kinds and numbers; table grid, spans and header row; picture size; footnote links | |
| 2 | In Word, Save `report.html` as DOCX | the DOCX; compare paragraph text and list/table structure with `report-from-html.docx` | |
| 3 | Open `report-from-html.docx` | opens without a repair prompt; page count; the same items as #1 | |
| 4 | Open `report.docx` and Save As "Web Page, Filtered" (`.htm`) | the HTML Word writes; text, list and table structure to compare with `report.html` | |
| 5 | Open `report.docx` and Save As "Web Page" (`.htm`) | same | |

What decides: Word's own HTML export is the reference for which constructs it writes for the same document (lists, tables, notes). Differences that
change the text or the structure are findings; differences in class names and inline style spelling are not.
